mechanism: row-to-core balance / cyclic full-stripe owner rotation
hypothesis: Rotating logical row-group owners on each full stripe by stripeGroup modulo blockCount may change block-to-row-band phase while preserving exact per-block row work.
change: For full stripes in GetGroupedStripeRow, compute stripeGroup = ordinal / groupWidth and ownerBlock = (logicalBlockIdx + stripeGroup % blockCount) % blockCount. The sparse-tail mapping remains the R046 evenly spaced owner mapping.

distinction_check.evidence: R047 changes the full-stripe owner formula from R045's odd/even mirror to cyclic rotation. R043-R046 already explored multiple row-owner placement variants; Main's route audit identified this mechanism as too close to those variants. No independent-mechanism or performance claim is made.
distinction_check.scope_note: This changes logical block ownership only; it does not establish physical-core behavior or performance benefit.

ownership_validation.command: static enumeration of exact row partition and per-block balance for blockCount 1..24, groupWidth 1..6, fullGroups 0..4, and every tail length
invariants: Every row is assigned exactly once across full stripes and the tail.
Per-block total row counts differ by at most one.
Every full stripe assigns one groupWidth-sized row group to each logical block.
ownership_validation.scope_note: Static mapping validation only; not runtime correctness, performance, or physical-core utilization validation.

scope_check.details: Only full-stripe logical block ownership changes, from parity-based mirroring to cyclic rotation. Sparse-tail ownership retains R046 behavior. Row group size, row counts, rowOffset = sourceRow * rowWidth, output row stride, GM transaction sizes, arithmetic, UB buffers, and reduction topology are unchanged.
